title: Roll unused budget into the next month
pr_description: Frequently requested feature: at month end, carry each category's unspent budget into the next month. Adds a next_month helper and rollover_budgets(), plus a test.

defects.description: next_month never rolls the year: next_month('2026-12') returns '2026-13', an impossible month key, so December rollovers write budgets no query will ever find.

set_budget upserts, so if the user already set a custom budget for the target month, rollover silently overwrites it with last month's limit plus carry. Requires knowing set_budget's ON CONFLICT semantics one function up.
The added rollover test asserts len(status) >= 0, which is always true. It cannot fail and verifies nothing about carried amounts, so both bugs above pass CI.
